title: Integral compact-support tower inputs and canonical reduction projections
statement: For the integral coefficient setting, define the input class by bounded constructibility and a common finite interval of Tor amplitudes for all reductions. For a strict compact-support reduction tower with specified evaluation comparisons, define its derived point-section tower, its integral sections by the completed homotopy limit, its actual projection to every finite level, and its reduction comparison by the normalized scalar-extension adjunction. The setting and constituent notions are those of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor], [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], [lem-pod-point-sections-derived-reduction], [lem-coef-integral-compact-support].
